# NT OFFICIAL SAFETY MANUAL ## SECTOR APPALIA MAJORIS ## CONFIDENTIAL — CENTRAL COMMAND PERSONNEL ONLY
[italic]If you are not Central Command staff and have come across this document, stop reading here and directly report to your [color=#1b67a5][bolditalic]Nanotrasen Representative[/bolditalic][/color] for guidance.[/italic]
In addition to full access to the [textlink="standard" link="CrewTrainingManual"] and [textlink="classified" link="ClassifiedTrainingManual"] safety manuals, Central Command finds it prescient to inform you of certain branches that may act on your Vessel.
## Internal Affairs
During your time serving as a representative of Nanotrasen, you may discover that plainclothes agents from Internal Affairs are auditing your local station. They have been supplied expanded radio access that allows direct communication to Central Command, and you should not interfere with or overtly aid them.
IA only hires the best and brightest for these endeavors, and these may require them to perform tasks or duties that are in violation of normal operating procedures or Space Law. This is not your concern, and we recommend that you go about your business should you witness them engaged in any activities related to their assignments. If you find yourself in a position to assist these agents in their work, do so only if you can ensure it remains off record and out of sight of non-Central Command personnel.
## Special Response Teams ("Deathsquad") In times of great crisis or when all conventional responses for an extreme station/sectoral threat are unavailable or have failed, NT will consider authorizing the deployment of a heavily armed Special Response Team (SRT) commonly known by the public as "Deathsquad". Should you be present for their deployment, you are to obey all orders given by them without question. SRT members are extensively trained and will execute their directives exactly as ordered, which may result in any non-compliant crew or potential hostiles being swiftly detained and/or neutralized.
Many station residents have a basic grasp of what an SRT is from various media sources or depictions, but will not be privy to their goals or capabilities. Please refrain from spreading rumors or discussing them in great lengths.
Nanotrasen would like to remind you that the Devil is often in the details.
